content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יוי, הַמֹּשֵׁל רָאשֵׁי עוֹלָם וְסוֹפָם.
content.english: Render blessing. unto Adonai, who rules over the universe’s origins and its end.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ הַבֹּחֵר לְעַמּוֹ, וּבְכוּר דָּת צְרָפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu habboḥer le‘ammo, uvkhur dat tserafam.
content.english: Render blessing. unto Him who has chosen His people, and refined them in the crucible of [His] Law.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ רָם אֲשֶׁר חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט אִלְּפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu ram asher ḥoḳ umishpat illefam.
content.english: Render blessing. unto the lofty One, who has taught them statutes and ordinances.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ נָעֳמוֹ, כִּי בְרַחֲמָיו רִבְּבָם וְהֶאֱלִיפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu na‘amo, ki veraḥamav ribbevam vehe’elifam.
content.english: Render blessing. [regarding] His pleasantness, for in His mercy he made them multiply into myriads and thousands.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ לוֹ, כִּי בִימִין עֻזּוֹ הֱנִיפָם.
content.english: Render blessing. unto Him, for He has waved them with His mighty right hand.
Render blessing. unto His name, [for] He has accumulated honor and glory for them.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ עֻזּוֹ, כִּי בְכֹהֲנֵי צֶֽדֶק רְצָפָם.
content.english: Render blessing. [regarding] His might, for He has given them an unbroken line of righteous priests.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ תּוֹרַת עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְחַטָּאת וְאָשָׁם חֲשָׂפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu torat ‘ola uminḥa veḥattat ve’asham ḥasafam.
content.english: Render blessing. [for] He has revealed to them the instructions of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ לוֹ, [מְקוֹם] זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים, יַד מַקְרִיב תְּנִיפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu lo, meḳom zivḥē shelamim, yad maḳriv tenifam.
content.english: Render blessing. unto Him, in place of the shelamim sacrifices, whose offeror would wave them by hand.
content.comments: Shelamim. A sacrifice whose meat is eaten by the offeror.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ מְקַדֵּשׁ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו, וּבִצְנִיף חֵן צְנָפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu meḳaddesh Aharon uvanav, uvitsnif ḥen tsenafam.
content.english: Render blessing. unto Him who sanctified Aaron and his sons, and turbaned them with beautiful turbans.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ שָׂם בְּלִבָּם אוּרִים לְהוֹרוֹת, וְשֹֽׁהַם עַל כְּתֵפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu sam belibbam urim lehorot, veshoham ‘al ketefam.
content.english: Render blessing. [for] He placed Urim on their heart, to give instruction, and green beryl on their shoulder.
Render blessing. [for] He changed their clothes to ones of glory and splendor.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ בְּשֶֽׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹֽדֶשׁ מָשַׁח רֹאשָׁם וְגוּפָם.
content.transliteration: Barekhu beshemen mish’ḥat ḳodesh mashaḥ rosham veḡufam.
content.english: Render blessing. [for] He anointed their heads and bodies with holy anointing-oil.

content.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ בְּשִׁבְעַת יָמִים שָׂם עֲלֵי תְרוּפָם.
content.english: Render blessing. [for] He gave seven days for their healing.
Render blessing. [for] He gathered them to dwell at the entrance to His tent.

content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barekhu asher mikkol goy he‘edifam.
content.english: Cong. Render blessing. unto Him who preferred them over every nation.

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּי־יַ֭עֲקֹב בָּחַ֣ר לוֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֜שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ: (תהלים קלה:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki Ya‘aḳov baḥar lo Yah Yisra’el lisḡulato:
content.english: Cantor. For Yah has chosen Jacob, Israel for His treasured [people]. (Ps. 135:4)

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Hear me, Jacob, and Israel, who are called by Me: I am He, I am the first, and I am also the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
